NEW YORK CITY, SEPTEMBER 5. 6. 7, 1962

Dear Brothers of Psi Upsilon:

The Annual Banquet will be held at the Waldorf on Thursday, the 6th.

This Convention in New York City is a great opportunity for brothers to gather to
gether. Not only will the Convention be an attraction but New York City is one of the
greatest drawing cards.
We will have a real job in estimating whether we will have 200, 400 or possibly 1,000!

We have written all Chapters and Alumni groups asking for representatives who will
act as sub-committee men. At this time, I am appealing for recommendations and for a
show of hands as to whether you will attend.

Yours in the bonds,
Russ McShane
Delta '32, Chairman
